Choose paired preimages at each original convex affine-cell image overlap before all later lifts. Convex fibers and local injectivity give lift factorization; clopen coincidence on convex overlaps detects deck collisions at the fixed marks. Connectedness of the full lifted deformation image forces a collision. The original finite measure |T|-|s(T)| strictly decreases.

Vertex-link and triangle coface counts imply chi(boundary)=2chi(region). Boundary top cycles intersect tetrahedron boundaries in the one-dimensional span of the entire frontier. Connectedness and rank-nullity yield b1(boundary)<=2b1(region), with disconnected boundary allowed. The disk and annulus bounds are separate specializations.

Whole-branch normalization, exact two-strip tube preimage, graphs of plus/minus max(|u|,b), explicit three-piece and five-piece source chains, two group identities selecting an excluded rim, boundary count decrease followed by rim-fixed interior circle reduction.

cross_chapter_contracts.statement: For a Hausdorff PL domain, a continuous disk with boundary in a relatively open frontier mark and class outside a normal subgroup gives a proper embedded PL disk with rim still outside that subgroup after explicit basepoint transport. The output rim need not equal the input rim.

A compact A in a PL domain R and an open W containing A admit compact PL K subset R intersect W with A in relative interior and exact domain/frontier agreement on an ambient open neighborhood of A. The construction is included in the chart-proper proof; coordinator should choose one shared exposition location.

A locally flat embedded two-sphere in E3 has exactly two open connected complementary components with that whole frontier; one is bounded with compact closure and unchanged frontier. This weaker separation result is used before lower-handle ball recognition.
cross_chapter_contracts.action: Place the separation theorem before the protected enclosing-region proof or provide a precise forward reference whose proof is independent of Dehn. Keep stronger Brown ball recognition in relative-rigidity.

cross_chapter_contracts.statement: Exact protected annulus or simultaneously disjoint disk pair for the same discrete lattice, original chart and retained block, with the same surfaces forming the frontier of a compact enclosing region together with the radius-3/2 attaching patch. Core containment is relative interior in the original domain, with strict outer transverse margin. Also export the standard proper disk with its entire prescribed PL boundary map.

HasHamiltonGeneralizedDehnInput is the conjunction of protected surfaces for full discrete lattices and the standard proper-disk family. Individual protected producers require only discreteness, not the extra full-lattice premise. This is one input to lowerCases_of_wall_dehn_prime, not the whole smoothing theorem.
